snippet.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Introducing the Isle of Ireland
snippet.description:
Get ready to explore the Isle of Ireland - a land of stunning natural beauty, rich history, and vibrant culture. This map expansion takes you across Ireland and Northern Ireland, offering a diverse and immersive driving journey through rolling green landscapes, scenic coastal roads, and dynamic cities.

Add this map expansion to your Steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851260/

Read more in our blog 👉 https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/10/introducing-ireland.html
